text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While out shopping one day, I spot
Nishino
Flower standing in a store's nail
product section.
She looks lost.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
This is all nail polish? There's so many. I
don't
even know where to start...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... How 'bout the one up there? It
dries quick
and doesn't chip easy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Jordan?! U-um, this isn't what it looks
like!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? So... you're not buying nail stuff?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Who, me? Th-that'd just look weird. I-I
mean, it's
not like doing my nails like an
adult will actually
make me one, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, no shame in owning up. Which
one do you
want?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-well, um...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For now, why don'tcha just pick a color
you vibe
with? Don't worry about the
base coat, I'll lend
you mine.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, then... a pink one. I think Bourbon
would like
that too...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you two are gonna match? Hmm...
How's one
of these pinks, then?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there, Jordan! You're
biasing her
decision!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hear her out first! Do you even know
why she's
here?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yikes, killjoy alert. C'mon, Flower, let's
go.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Killjoy?! I'm only giving my sincere
advice as a
class repre—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All right, all right! If you're so worried,
why don't
you tag along then? That goes
for you over there
too, snoops!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Paint all the way to the edges... but not
too far...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower carefully follows Tosen
Jordan's
instructions as she paints the
nails I offered up for
practice. They turn
out a lovely pink.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yep, looking good. All that's left is to
let them
dry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea just painting them would
be so
difficult. Maybe I'm still not ready
for this...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look. Painting your nails—all
fashion,
really—is something you do for
yourself, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's like when you look in the mirror after
doing
your makeup, and you're like,
"Wow, you're
killing it, girl." Kinda like
our signature racewear
too, actually.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah! I get super fired up when I put
mine on!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right? So if you wanna give off grown-up vibes, you gotta look the part so you can feel the part! Here—lean over for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan pulls out a translucent lip
gloss
from her pouch and applies it to
Nishino Flower's
lips.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Not much difference

looks-wise, but you feel glowed-up,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Ehehe, you're right. I already feel a
little
more mature!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There you go. Told you—look the part
and the
rest'll follow.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I wholeheartedly agree! As class
representative, I
make sure I always look
the part!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh... Actually, your hair's, like, never not perfect. Don't tell me you're the super fussy type?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha, so you've noticed! I always
keep my
hair in order—just like my
priorities! As soon as
it's tied up, I'm in
full class rep mode!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So you start with looks too! I remember
when
Jordan did my nails during the
sweets
competition—I felt like a
grown-up!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm... I'm going to get better at doing my
nails!
Jordan, please teach me
everything you know!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Bet. Hit me up whenever, 'kay?
